Renders a list of threaded comments: each root with its sorted replies and an optional inline reply box. Fully controlled — mutations route through the id-keyed callbacks.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/comments/CommentThreadList.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { CommentThreadList } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/comments";
```
